lines: Phase 2 is closed at its limit, not as a pass: the second and last blockout review scored 6 and 8, merged 6 against a bar of 7, with no severe issue open
All 15 machine and deliverable checks are green on the final blockout build, and the preview film is committed

Five open issues are carried: the opening's easing and the spring move (fixed next, judged with the film), headroom in the shake and the macro framing (look lock), the phone's sound control (interface)
Phase 3, the look lock, has started: the real photographs and two clips of a globe being shaken are studied, and the build of the real winter globe is being split across supporting agents
phase 3: 0.23 h used of its 11.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 6.84 h used of 36.00 h allowed
